name: LD6004 3D Presence Radar
description: The `ld6004` component allows you to use the Hi-Link HLK-LD6004 60 GHz 3D presence radar module with ESPHome. It can track up to 3 people and reports per-target position (X/Y/Z), cluster ID, and Doppler index.

config_entries.label: UART ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the [UART Component](https://esphome.io/components/uart/) to use. Required if you have multiple UARTs configured.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID for this component.
